rows.text: Kinnan adds one extra mana every time you tap a nonland permanent for mana. On paper that is ramp; in practice it is a combo engine. Basalt Monolith taps for three, Kinnan adds a fourth, and untapping costs three, so you gain one mana per cycle for as many cycles as you like. This is the Bracket 5 version: the counterspells are free, the mana is fast, the deck holds six independent infinite-mana combos, and the game is expected to end on a single turn around turn four.

rows.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy
rows.text: two mana. Whenever you tap a nonland permanent for mana, add one more mana of a type it made: Sol Ring makes three and a Mox makes two. Lands do not count. His {5}{G}{U} ability looks at the top five cards and puts a non-Human creature straight onto the battlefield.
That ability needs real green and blue. Colourless from the Monoliths cannot pay the {G}{U} part unless Agatha's Soul Cauldron is out.

rows.name: Delighted Halfling
rows.text: its coloured mana makes a legendary spell uncounterable, which is how Kinnan and Thrasios resolve through a table of blue decks.

rows.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy + Basalt Monolith
rows.text: tap for three, Kinnan adds one, untap for three: unlimited colourless. Two cards, and most of the tutors point at the Monolith.

rows.name: Basalt Monolith + Power Artifact
rows.text: the untap costs {1}, so the Monolith nets two colourless a cycle with no Kinnan. This line survives removal on the commander.

rows.name: Grim Monolith + Power Artifact
rows.text: the untap drops from {4} to {2} against three mana out, so it nets one a cycle (two with Kinnan). Grim Monolith with Kinnan alone is mana-neutral, not infinite: four in, four to untap.

rows.name: Nyxbloom Ancient + Basalt Monolith
rows.text: Nyxbloom triples what the Monolith makes, so it taps for nine against a three-mana untap. Grim Monolith does the same, nine against four. Kinnan's extra mana is not tripled; it does not come from tapping.

rows.name: Bloom Tender + Freed from the Real
rows.text: Freed is blue and Bloom Tender is green, so Bloom Tender taps for {G}{U} and untapping costs {U}: one green profit per cycle. With Kinnan each tap adds a third mana of green or blue, which makes unlimited green and blue: enough to pay Kinnan's dig, Finale and Thassa's Oracle directly.

rows.name: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal
rows.text: imprint Reversal. Pay {2} and tap the Scepter to cast a free copy, which untaps every nonland permanent you control, the Scepter included. Each loop makes everything your rocks and dorks produce, minus two; with Kinnan, Sol Ring alone makes three. Every copy is a spell cast: unlimited storm and cast triggers.
Without the Scepter, Dramatic Reversal is still a huge ritual: with Kinnan out, every rock and dork untaps and pays again, each with Kinnan's extra mana.

guide.title: Turning unlimited mana into a win

rows.name: Thrasios, Triton Hero -> Thassa's Oracle
rows.text: the cleanest kill. Pay {4} (colourless works) to Thrasios until your library is empty, with lands entering tapped and everything else drawn, then cast Thassa's Oracle for {U}{U}. With no cards left in your library, its trigger wins the game. Keep {U}{U} untapped first, because the lands Thrasios finds enter tapped. Stop activating once the library is empty: a Thrasios draw from an empty library loses.

rows.name: Walking Ballista
rows.text: the second kill. Cast it from your hand with X as large as you like and ping the table. Kinnan's dig, Chord, Finale, Nature's Rhythm and Whir put it onto the battlefield with X = 0, where it dies, so draw it or tutor it to hand instead.

rows.name: Walking Ballista -> Agatha's Soul Cauldron
rows.text: if Ballista is in your graveyard, including right after it died entering with X = 0, exile it with the Cauldron. The Cauldron then puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control, and every creature of yours with a counter gains Ballista's {4} and its ping.

rows.name: Kinnan, Bonder Prodigy + Basalt Monolith + Agatha's Soul Cauldron
rows.text: the Cauldron lets you spend mana as though it were any colour on creature abilities, so the Monolith's colourless pays Kinnan's {5}{G}{U}. Dig until every non-Human creature is on the battlefield. Thassa's Oracle is a non-Human too, so dig only AFTER Thrasios has emptied the library, or hold Oracle in hand; its trigger is wasted if it enters while you still have cards in your library.

rows.name: Finale of Devastation
rows.text: with X of ten or more it fetches any creature and gives your board +X/+X and haste. It needs {G}{G} of real green.

rows.name: Invasion of Ikoria
rows.text: with unlimited mana, X fetches any non-Human creature from your library or graveyard. Defeat the battle in combat and it becomes Zilortha, Apex of Ikoria, and your non-Humans can assign combat damage as though unblocked. It is a fallback for a turn without Oracle or Ballista.

rows.name: Isochron Scepter + Dramatic Reversal + Hullbreaker Horror
rows.text: every Reversal copy is a spell cast, so Hullbreaker returns one opposing nonland permanent to hand per loop. Run the Scepter until their boards are empty.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.text: With Kinnan out, find Basalt Monolith. With Kinnan dead or under threat, find the Monolith and Power Artifact. Holding Freed from the Real? Find Bloom Tender. Holding Dramatic Reversal? Find Isochron Scepter. Once mana is unlimited, find Thrasios, then Thassa's Oracle or Walking Ballista.

rows.name: Whir of Invention -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: instant speed, and improvise lets your rocks pay. Cast it on the end step before your turn or in response to artifact removal. X = 2 finds Isochron Scepter or Agatha's Soul Cauldron instead.

rows.name: Trophy Mage -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: searches for a mana value three artifact to hand. It is a Human, so Kinnan cannot dig it out.

rows.name: Drift of Phantasms -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: transmute for {1}{U}{U} at sorcery speed for any mana value three card: the Monolith, Freed from the Real or Whir of Invention.

rows.name: Transmute Artifact -> Basalt Monolith
rows.text: sacrifice a Talisman or Signet (mana value two) and pay {1}; the Monolith goes straight onto the battlefield. Sacrifice a spent Mana Vault (mana value one) and pay {2}.

rows.name: Formidable Speaker -> Thassa's Oracle
rows.text: discard a card to put any creature in your hand: Oracle or Walking Ballista for the kill, or Bloom Tender for the Aura loop.

rows.name: Green Sun's Zenith -> Bloom Tender
rows.text: X = 2 puts it onto the battlefield. It cannot tap for the loop until your next turn, so fetch it a turn ahead.

rows.name: Chord of Calling -> Thrasios, Triton Hero
rows.text: instant speed and convoke: fetch Thrasios on an opponent's end step so he can draw on your turn.

rows.name: Nature's Rhythm -> Nyxbloom Ancient
rows.text: X = 7 puts Nyxbloom onto the battlefield, where it triples your Monolith. Harmonize casts it once more from the graveyard.

rows.name: Finale of Devastation -> Thrasios, Triton Hero
rows.text: a small X is a tutor from library or graveyard. X = 2 finds Thrasios or Bloom Tender.

Each of these can become a second Basalt Monolith (useful when the first is destroyed in response), a second Nyxbloom Ancient, or a copy of the best permanent an opponent controls. Do not copy Kinnan: the legend rule makes you keep only one.

rows.name: Copy Artifact
rows.text: cheap, and it copies their Sol Ring as happily as your Monolith.

rows.name: Phyrexian Metamorph
rows.text: two life instead of blue mana, and it copies creatures too.

rows.name: Clever Impersonator
rows.text: any nonland permanent.

rows.name: Mirage Mirror
rows.text: becomes anything on the battlefield for {2}, repeatedly, at instant speed. A Mirror copying Basalt Monolith is a second Monolith for the combo.

rows.name: Gilded Drake
rows.text: two mana to take their commander.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: turn one, every time; three mana with Kinnan.

rows.name: Mana Vault
rows.text: three on turn one, four with Kinnan.

rows.name: Grim Monolith
rows.text: three on turn two, four with Kinnan, and half of a Power Artifact combo.

rows.name: Lotus Petal
rows.text: free, and Kinnan's extra mana comes with it.

rows.name: Mox Amber
rows.text: live the moment Kinnan or Thrasios resolves.

rows.name: Mox Diamond
rows.text: a land for a Mox in a deck that does not need many lands.

rows.name: Mox Opal
rows.text: metalcraft comes quickly here.

rows.name: Chrome Mox
rows.text: fast, at the cost of a card.

rows.name: Elvish Spirit Guide
rows.text: a free green from hand on turn one.

rows.name: Birds of Paradise
rows.text: any colour, two mana with Kinnan.

rows.name: Llanowar Elves
rows.text: two green under Kinnan.

rows.name: Elvish Mystic
rows.text: the second copy.

rows.name: Fyndhorn Elves
rows.text: the third.

rows.name: Springleaf Drum
rows.text: taps a summoning-sick creature for mana, plus one with Kinnan.

rows.name: Gene Pollinator
rows.text: taps any permanent for one mana of any colour, plus one with Kinnan.

rows.name: Enduring Vitality
rows.text: every creature you control taps for any colour, and it comes back as an enchantment when it dies.

rows.name: Badgermole Cub
rows.text: an extra green whenever you tap a creature for mana, including each Bloom Tender untap.

rows.name: Seedborn Muse
rows.text: untaps everything on all three opponents' turns, Basalt Monolith included, so you get three extra full mana pools per round.

rows.name: Force of Will
rows.text: the free counterspell that defines the format.

rows.name: Force of Negation
rows.text: free on their turn against noncreature spells.

rows.name: Pact of Negation
rows.text: free now. Win before your next upkeep, when its cost comes due.

rows.name: Fierce Guardianship
rows.text: free with your commander out.

rows.name: Flusterstorm
rows.text: nearly unbeatable in a counter war.

rows.name: Swan Song
rows.text: one mana for a wrath, a removal spell or an enchantment.

rows.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
rows.text: the same for anything noncreature.

rows.name: Mental Misstep
rows.text: two life for their turn-one accelerant.

rows.name: Disrupting Shoal
rows.text: free, and it names their exact mana value.

rows.name: Mindbreak Trap
rows.text: free against a storm turn, and it exiles.

rows.name: Misdirection
rows.text: free, and it turns their removal or tutor into yours.

rows.name: Commandeer
rows.text: free, and it steals their combo piece outright.

rows.name: Veil of Summer
rows.text: one mana that beats blue and black interaction and draws.

rows.name: Endurance
rows.text: free graveyard hate at instant speed, and a 3/4 reach blocker.

rows.name: Chain of Vapor
rows.text: one mana to bounce anything, including your own permanent in response to removal.

rows.name: Amphibian Downpour
rows.text: flash and storm. After a Scepter loop it turns every opposing creature into a 1/1 Frog.

rows.name: The One Ring
rows.text: a full turn of protection, then an escalating draw engine.

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: their turns pay for yours.

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: the strongest card in the deck on turns one through four.

rows.name: Consecrated Sphinx
rows.text: two cards for every card an opponent draws: the fair game's engine.

rows.name: Faerie Mastermind
rows.text: flash, flies, and draws off the table's extra draws.

rows.name: Wan Shi Tong, Librarian
rows.text: scales, draws on entry, and punishes every tutor at the table.

rows.name: Valley Floodcaller
rows.text: your noncreature spells gain flash, and each one untaps your Birds. Birds of Paradise taps again for two with Kinnan.

rows.name: High Fae Trickster
rows.text: every spell gains flash, so the whole combo turn can happen on their end step.

rows.name: Borne Upon a Wind
rows.text: the cheap version of the same effect, and it draws a card.

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep fast mana and interaction. A hand with Sol Ring or two Moxen plus a Force effect is a keep; a hand of value creatures is not. This deck expects to win around turn four and must survive somebody else trying to win on turn three.

Kinnan matters most, so protect the cast. Delighted Halfling makes him uncounterable; otherwise hold a Force effect rather than jamming him into open blue mana. If he dies anyway, the Monoliths with Power Artifact, Nyxbloom Ancient, and Bloom Tender with Freed all still go infinite.
Find Basalt Monolith, not a bigger creature. Whir of Invention, Trophy Mage, Drift of Phantasms and Transmute Artifact all point at the same three-mana rock.
With unlimited mana, the order is: Thrasios until the library is empty, then Thassa's Oracle. If Oracle is gone, cast Walking Ballista from hand. Dig with Kinnan only once the Oracle is safe in hand.
